top_signals.title: Google to invest record $15 billion in AI infrastructure in the 'Texas of Europe'
top_signals.summary: Google on Wednesday said it would invest $15.1 billion into AI infrastructure in Finland, marking the tech giant's largest single investment in Europe.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
